statement: For the ordinary red-blue edge-coloring problem on the three-uniform Kneser graph, KG(11,3) admits a complete two-coloring of its 4,620 edges in which none of its 15,400 triangles is monochromatic. Consequently R_3^KG(3,3) >= 12. This does not decide the KG(12,3) case, so the frozen original exact-value problem remains unresolved with value in {12,13}.
contribution: An exact, exhaustively checkable 4,620-edge construction settles the previously listed KG(11,3) finite case on the colorable side and improves the cited lower bound from 11 to 12. The attached literature screen found no equivalent later arXiv result as of 2026-09-10, but makes no priority guarantee.
